title: Pocket capture conditions
purpose: Validates the pocket state machine (doc section 9): the drop threshold, the rattle-out case and the minimum speed to reach the drop.
sources: Dr. Dave, 'Pocket Effective Size and Center'

setup.note: the ball is placed on the centre line of a corner pocket and rolls straight in at 1.5 m/s

expectations.notes: a ball entering on the centre line must drop
sqrt(2*mu_r*g*shelf_depth) for a ball rolling across the mouth; a ball still sliding there uses mu_slate instead. Slower balls hang up on the shelf.

invariants.statement: a ball whose centre merely crosses the mouth line is NOT pocketed; the centre must cross the drop line
the ideal aim point of a corner pocket shifts with entry angle and speed by up to ~0.6 inch (Dr. Dave)
a ball that rattles in the jaws must produce the same outcome on every run and on every platform (no wall-clock, no hash ordering)
